Description: Damian Maseko escorts the visibly drunken Doyle to Edmund Galley’s room to settle her to rest, and in a private conversation reveals information about relationships, the lost ring, and family members.
Location: Edmund Galley’s room (Edmund's room)
Key Information:
  - Damian Maseko (No. 8) follows the prior arrangement, supports Doyle (No. 10) to Edmund Galley’s room, and settles her on the bed to rest.
  - Doyle explicitly asks that her younger brother be called to accompany her when she needs someone, and says she can recognize him by the way he knocks.
  - Damian Maseko warns Doyle not to let anyone else into the room before her brother arrives, and explicitly points out that there is an outsider in the villa.
  - Their conversation repeatedly mentions Victoria Maseko (Vic) and Edmund Galley (Eddie), implying a complicated emotional relationship among the three.
  - Doyle mentions she argued with Edmund Galley, lost her ring while drunk, and hopes Edmund Galley can find it.
  - Recorder’s note: The system提示 that the “find” command can be used to search keywords (e.g., “ring”), indicating the item may have clue value in later investigation.
  - After confirming Doyle is relatively stable, Damian Maseko leaves the room, saying he will go call her younger brother to come.
  - Doyle (No. 10) rests alone in Edmund Galley’s room and falls asleep.
Characters:
  [Damian Maseko (Damian Maseko)] Person No. 8, one of the villa residents.
    · Takes Doyle to Edmund Galley’s room to rest as requested by Harry Thornton.
    · Warns Doyle to watch out for outsiders and restricts others from entering the room.
    · Says he will go call Doyle’s younger brother to accompany her.
    · Reveals in conversation that he is fairly familiar with Victoria Maseko.
  [Doyle] Person No. 10, a female resident who is clearly intoxicated.
    · Is settled in Edmund Galley’s room to rest due to intoxication.
    · Asks that her younger brother be called when needed and says she can recognize his knock.
    · Mentions arguing with Edmund Galley and losing the ring while drunk.
    · Hints at emotional tension among herself, Edmund Galley, and Victoria Maseko.
